law: Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 (India) + DPDP Rules, 2025 (notified 14 Nov 2025)
updateNote: v2.0.0 adds the CLD (Cloud Posture) category, resolved automatically by the AWS connector (docs/INFRA-SCANNER-SPEC.md). When MeitY notifies amendments, publish a new rulebook version file (v2, v3...). The engine re-evaluates all clients against the new version and the diff engine reports newly-introduced checkpoints as TBC, never silently.

statusValues.PARTIAL: Some but not all elements satisfied; evidence shows both
statusValues.GAP: Checkpoint applicable and not satisfied; evidence of absence recorded
statusValues.NA: Not applicable to this organisation, with the reason recorded
statusValues.TBC: Applicable but insufficient evidence to determine; needs manual input

checkMethods.web: Determined automatically by the website/app scanner
checkMethods.questionnaire: Determined from structured departmental questionnaire answers
checkMethods.evidence: Determined by a human uploading/attaching evidence (document, screenshot, register)
checkMethods.hybrid: Automated signal exists but manual confirmation is required to mark COMPLIANT

categories.name: Cookies, Tracking & Online Consent
categories.legalRef: DPDPA s.5-6 applied to online tracking

categories.name: Cloud Posture (automated via connectors)
categories.legalRef: DPDPA s.8(5); Rule 6 applied to cloud infrastructure

controls.title: Privacy notice exists and is reachable
controls.description: A privacy notice/policy is published and linked from every data-collection surface (website footer, app, forms).
controls.evidenceRequired: URL of notice; link locations
controls.remediation: Publish a DPDPA-aligned privacy notice and link it site-wide and in-app.

appAssist.how: Generate a notice draft from the data inventory for counsel review

controls.title: Notice itemises personal data and purposes
controls.description: The notice gives an itemised description of the personal data collected and the specified purposes, and lists the goods/services enabled by processing.
controls.evidenceRequired: Notice text sections mapped to the actual data inventory
controls.remediation: Rewrite notice per-purpose with an itemised data list matching the live inventory.

appAssist.how: Cross-check notice text against discovered data categories and flag mismatches

controls.title: Notice explains how to exercise rights and complain to the Board
controls.description: Notice describes how to withdraw consent, exercise rights, and make a complaint to the Data Protection Board of India.
controls.evidenceRequired: Relevant notice sections
controls.remediation: Add rights, withdrawal and Board-complaint sections with working links.

appAssist.how: Template clauses supplied for counsel review

controls.title: Notice available in English and the 22 Eighth-Schedule languages
controls.description: Data principals can access the notice in English or any language in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
controls.evidenceRequired: Language selector / translated notice URLs
controls.remediation: Publish translated notices or an on-demand language mechanism.

appAssist.how: Track translation coverage; machine-draft translations for human review

controls.title: Notice served at or before collection, and to legacy data principals
controls.description: Notice is presented at/before each collection point; data principals whose consent predates DPDPA have been served the notice 'as soon as reasonably practicable'.
controls.evidenceRequired: Screenshots of collection points; record of legacy-notice campaign
controls.remediation: Embed notice link at each form/IVR script; run a one-time legacy notice campaign (email/SMS).

appAssist.how: Detect forms lacking a notice link; track legacy-campaign evidence

controls.title: Proof of the exact notice version served
controls.description: The organisation can prove which version of the notice was shown at the time of each collection.
controls.evidenceRequired: Notice version log linked to consent records
controls.remediation: Version notices; store notice-version id with every consent record.

appAssist.how: Notice version registry with hashes and effective dates

controls.title: Consent is free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous
controls.description: Consent is collected by clear affirmative action, per specified purpose, limited to data necessary for that purpose.
controls.evidenceRequired: Consent UX screenshots per channel; consent record schema
controls.remediation: Redesign consent capture per-purpose; remove bundled/generic consent.

appAssist.how: Purpose registry + per-purpose consent state model

controls.title: Consent captured on all web/app forms
controls.description: Every form collecting personal data has an unticked, explicit consent control with a notice link.
controls.evidenceRequired: Per-form scan evidence (form URL, fields, consent control present/absent)
controls.remediation: Add a consent widget to every collecting form; no pre-ticked boxes.

appAssist.how: Scanner enumerates forms and flags missing consent controls on each re-scan

controls.title: Verbal / assisted-channel consent is recorded and retrievable
controls.description: Consent captured by phone, IVR, callbot, email or agents is timestamped, stored and retrievable against the data principal record.
controls.evidenceRequired: Sample retrieval of a verbal consent record (call id, timestamp, purpose)
controls.remediation: Log consent events from telephony systems into a consent register keyed by data principal.

appAssist.how: Consent register API accepting IVR/dialer webhook events

controls.title: Withdrawal is as easy as giving consent
controls.description: A data principal can withdraw consent with comparable ease; withdrawal ceases processing (except where another lawful ground exists).
controls.evidenceRequired: Withdrawal UX; processing-stop evidence
controls.remediation: Provide self-serve withdrawal per purpose.

appAssist.how: Hosted preference/withdrawal page + downstream suppression signal

controls.title: Withdrawal propagates to downstream systems and processors
controls.description: On withdrawal, the fiduciary and its processors cease processing within a reasonable time; suppression reaches CRM, marketing, SMS/WhatsApp/email tools.
controls.evidenceRequired: Suppression logs across downstream tools for a test withdrawal
controls.remediation: Automate withdrawal fan-out via API/webhooks to all processors.

appAssist.how: Webhook fan-out with delivery receipts as evidence

controls.title: Immutable consent log
controls.description: Every consent event (grant, refusal, withdrawal) is logged with timestamp, purpose, notice version, channel/source, and is tamper-evident.
controls.evidenceRequired: Consent log schema + sample records + integrity mechanism
controls.remediation: Append-only consent ledger with hash chaining.

appAssist.how: Provides the append-only ledger with hash chaining

controls.title: Consent Manager interoperability readiness
controls.description: Where a data principal uses a registered Consent Manager, the fiduciary can receive/honour consent signals through it (framework operationalising during 2026).
controls.evidenceRequired: Integration assessment or roadmap
controls.remediation: Assess Consent Manager APIs when registration opens; plan integration.

appAssist.how: Tracks readiness item; adapter layer planned in roadmap

controls.title: Processing limited to consented purpose
controls.description: Downstream processes (enrichment, campaigns, verification) check consent state for the specific purpose before processing.
controls.evidenceRequired: Purpose-check integration evidence in downstream systems
controls.remediation: Gate downstream jobs on per-purpose consent lookups.

appAssist.how: Consent-state lookup API for downstream systems

controls.title: Cookie consent banner / CMP present
controls.description: Sites and online catalogs present a consent mechanism before non-essential cookies/trackers fire; visitors can accept or decline.
controls.evidenceRequired: Scan evidence: CMP script or banner markup present/absent
controls.remediation: Deploy a CMP with granular categories across web, catalogs, app.

appAssist.how: Detects CMP presence and category granularity on every scan

controls.title: No non-essential cookies/trackers before consent
controls.description: Analytics/advertising cookies and pixels do not fire until affirmative consent.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cookies and tracker scripts observed on first uncooked request
controls.remediation: Configure tag manager to hold tags until consent signal.

appAssist.how: First-request cookie/tracker capture as evidence each scan

controls.title: Consent Mode / tag governance wired to CMP
controls.description: Google Consent Mode v2 (or equivalent) reflects the visitor's choice; declined analytics is demonstrably suppressed.
controls.evidenceRequired: Consent Mode signals in page source; GA behaviour on decline
controls.remediation: Enable Consent Mode v2 and bind to CMP categories.

appAssist.how: Detects gtag consent defaults in page source

controls.title: Cookie inventory documented with purposes
controls.description: A cookie register lists each cookie, purpose class (auth/functional/analytics/ads) and duration; the notice reflects it.
controls.evidenceRequired: Observed cookies vs documented register
controls.remediation: Maintain the cookie register; auto-reconcile against scans.

appAssist.how: Auto-builds observed-cookie list and diffs against the register

controls.title: Mobile app consent SDK / in-app consent
controls.description: Android/iOS apps present notice and capture consent equivalent to web, including for device identifiers and location.
controls.evidenceRequired: App consent screens; SDK configuration
controls.remediation: Integrate a consent SDK or native consent screens in both apps.

appAssist.how: Verification via evidence upload; automated app scanning on roadmap

controls.title: Age position assessed and documented
controls.description: The organisation has determined whether it processes children's (<18) data and documented its age-assurance approach (a B2B platform can document why exposure is low, plus mitigations).
controls.evidenceRequired: Documented age-assurance assessment
controls.remediation: Document the B2B position; add age declaration where sign-up is open.

appAssist.how: Assessment template + evidence tracking

controls.title: Verifiable parental consent where children's data is processed
controls.description: If children's data is knowingly processed, verifiable parental consent is obtained (DigiLocker/identity-based verification per Rule 10).
controls.evidenceRequired: Parental consent flow evidence
controls.remediation: Implement verifiable parental consent or restrict under-18 access.

appAssist.how: Tracked as evidence item; implementation is client-side

controls.title: No tracking/behavioural ads targeted at children
controls.description: No behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children.
controls.evidenceRequired: Ad-platform audience settings; policy statement
controls.remediation: Exclude minors from ad audiences; document settings.

appAssist.how: Evidence tracking only

controls.title: Formal DSR intake channel published
controls.description: A published, findable channel exists for access, correction, erasure and withdrawal requests, with the mechanism described in the notice.
controls.evidenceRequired: DSR page/email discoverable on site; notice reference
controls.remediation: Publish a DSR portal or dedicated channel with identity verification.

appAssist.how: Hosted DSR intake form + register

controls.title: DSR workflow with register, identity verification and SLA tracking
controls.description: Requests are logged in a register, identity-verified, routed to system owners and answered within the published timeline (Rules require stated response timelines; DSR responses within 90 days).
controls.evidenceRequired: DSR register extract; SLA metrics
controls.remediation: Stand up a DSR workflow with SLA clocks and audit trail.

appAssist.how: Provides DSR register with SLA tracking and evidence export

controls.title: Access request delivers a complete response pack
controls.description: A data principal receives a summary of their personal data, processing activities, and the identities of fiduciaries/processors with whom it was shared.
controls.evidenceRequired: Sample (dummy) access response pack
controls.remediation: Automate data retrieval across systems for access requests.

appAssist.how: Response-pack assembly checklist per system of record

controls.title: Erasure executed across systems and processors with evidence
controls.description: Erasure requests propagate to every system of record and processor; completion is evidenced (closure certificate).
controls.evidenceRequired: Erasure task trail for a test request
controls.remediation: Map systems holding personal data; route erasure tasks with owner sign-off.

appAssist.how: Erasure task routing + closure certificate generation

controls.title: Grievance redressal published with response timeline
controls.description: A grievance mechanism with a stated response period is published; escalation to the Board is explained.
controls.evidenceRequired: Grievance page/contact discoverable; stated timelines
controls.remediation: Publish grievance contact and timelines on site and in notice.

appAssist.how: Detects grievance contact presence on each scan

controls.title: Nomination facility offered
controls.description: Data principals can nominate another individual to exercise rights in case of death or incapacity.
controls.evidenceRequired: Nomination mechanism description
controls.remediation: Add nomination option to the DSR/preference surface.

appAssist.how: Nomination field in hosted DSR portal

controls.title: Reasonable security safeguards implemented and documented
controls.description: Documented safeguards covering the Rule 6 minimum: encryption/obfuscation/masking or virtual tokens; access control; logging & monitoring; backups; and contractual safeguards with processors.
controls.evidenceRequired: Security policy; control implementation evidence
controls.remediation: Adopt and evidence the Rule 6 minimum control set.

appAssist.how: Control checklist with per-control evidence attachments

controls.title: Encryption at rest and in transit for personal data
controls.description: Personal data stores and transports are encrypted (TLS in transit; disk/db/file encryption at rest) or tokenised/masked.
controls.evidenceRequired: TLS scan evidence; at-rest encryption attestation per store
controls.remediation: Enforce TLS everywhere; enable at-rest encryption on databases, buckets, backups.

appAssist.how: External TLS verification; at-rest tracked via evidence

controls.title: Role-based access control incl. outsourced workforce
controls.description: Access to personal data is role-restricted with authentication, covering employees, BPO partners and channel partners; access is reviewed periodically.
controls.evidenceRequired: RBAC matrix; last access-review record incl. third parties
controls.remediation: Implement RBAC uniformly; quarterly access reviews including partners.

appAssist.how: Access-review workflow with attestation records

controls.title: Logging, monitoring and 1-year log retention
controls.description: Access/processing logs are kept and monitored to detect unauthorised access; logs retained at least one year.
controls.evidenceRequired: Log retention config; monitoring/alerting evidence
controls.remediation: Centralise logs, set >=1y retention, add anomaly alerts.

appAssist.how: Retention checklist; scan verifies public endpoints only

controls.title: Backups and continuity for personal data
controls.description: Backups enable continued processing in case of destruction/loss; restore is tested.
controls.evidenceRequired: Backup policy; last restore test
controls.remediation: Schedule backups; run and record restore tests.

appAssist.how: Evidence tracking with recurring reminders

controls.title: Maker-checker approval for changes to customer data
controls.description: Changes/amendments to customer records follow a documented approval flow with an audit trail.
controls.evidenceRequired: Approval workflow doc; sample audit trail
controls.remediation: Introduce maker-checker workflow on data-change requests.

appAssist.how: Configurable approval workflow module (roadmap)

controls.title: Breach response documented and rehearsed
controls.description: A written incident-response process exists, with roles, severity assessment and departmental rehearsal.
controls.evidenceRequired: IR plan; drill record
controls.remediation: Adopt an IR plan; run a tabletop drill.

appAssist.how: Incident register + drill tracker

controls.title: Board and data-principal breach notification capability
controls.description: On becoming aware of a breach: intimate affected data principals without delay (plain-language description, mitigation, contact), notify the Board without delay, and file the detailed report within 72 hours.
controls.evidenceRequired: Notification templates; contact data readiness; register
controls.remediation: Prepare Board + data-principal templates and a tested dispatch path.

appAssist.how: Generates statutory notification drafts from the incident register

controls.title: Documented retention schedule per data category
controls.description: A retention schedule states, per category/purpose, how long personal data is kept and the erasure trigger; 'until deletion request' alone is not a schedule.
controls.evidenceRequired: Retention schedule document
controls.remediation: Publish a retention schedule; map every store to it.

appAssist.how: Retention schedule builder tied to the data inventory

controls.title: Erasure on purpose-served or consent withdrawal
controls.description: Personal data is erased (and processors instructed to erase) when purpose is served and retention is no longer legally required. Class-notified fiduciaries (e-commerce/social/gaming above thresholds) must erase after 3 years of user inactivity with 48-hour prior notice.
controls.evidenceRequired: Deletion job evidence; 48h notice mechanism if in scope
controls.remediation: Implement automated deletion runs with logs; add pre-erasure notice if class-notified.

appAssist.how: Deletion-evidence register; inactivity clock tracking

controls.title: Deletion evidence retained
controls.description: Each deletion run produces evidence (what category, which systems, when, by whom) suitable for audit.
controls.evidenceRequired: Deletion logs/certificates
controls.remediation: Log deletion runs; retain certificates.

appAssist.how: Deletion certificate generation

controls.title: Valid contracts (DPAs) with every processor
controls.description: Every processor (cloud, comms, analytics, BPO, channel partners) operates under a valid contract requiring security safeguards and data protection obligations with liability flow-down.
controls.evidenceRequired: Processor register with DPA status per processor
controls.remediation: Execute/refresh DPAs for all processors; track expiry.

appAssist.how: Processor register with DPA status, risk score and review reminders

controls.title: Processor register maintained as a living record
controls.description: A register lists each processor, data shared, purpose, location, and review date; new tools enter the register before go-live.
controls.evidenceRequired: Register extract; last review date
controls.remediation: Adopt the register; wire procurement to it.

appAssist.how: This tool maintains the register and diffs observed trackers/vendors against it

controls.title: No sale/rent of personal data; sharing limited to lawful bases
controls.description: Personal data is shared only with consented/lawful recipients; observed third-party scripts and data flows reconcile to the register.
controls.evidenceRequired: Observed third parties on scan vs register
controls.remediation: Remove unregistered trackers; document each observed third party.

appAssist.how: Every scan reconciles observed third parties against the register

controls.title: Erasure/withdrawal instructions flow to processors
controls.description: Processors demonstrably receive and honour erasure and suppression instructions.
controls.evidenceRequired: Processor confirmation records for a test instruction
controls.remediation: Add erasure/suppression clauses and API hooks per processor.

appAssist.how: Instruction dispatch log with delivery receipts

controls.title: Cross-border transfer register with basis
controls.description: Transfers of personal data outside India (incl. international buyer/seller matching) are recorded with country, recipient, category and basis; restricted-country notifications are checked.
controls.evidenceRequired: Transfer register extract
controls.remediation: Create the transfer register; add a restricted-country check to the flow.

appAssist.how: Transfer register with country-restriction lookups against notified lists

controls.title: Government-notified transfer conditions honoured
controls.description: Any conditions/notified restrictions on transfer (including sector-specific and SDF localisation orders) are identified and applied.
controls.evidenceRequired: Assessment note against current notifications
controls.remediation: Monitor MeitY notifications; reflect in transfer rules.

appAssist.how: Rulebook updates propagate notified changes to this checkpoint

controls.title: Published contact for data protection questions
controls.description: The business publishes (site + notice) the contact details of the person who answers questions about processing — the DPO where required.
controls.evidenceRequired: Contact discoverable on site and in notice
controls.remediation: Publish the contact on the website footer/privacy page.

appAssist.how: Detects presence on each scan

controls.title: Departmental accountability map and living RoPA
controls.description: A maintained record maps processes, departments, systems, data categories and flows (the departmental questionnaire becomes a living record, not a one-time exercise).
controls.evidenceRequired: Current data-flow inventory with last-updated dates
controls.remediation: Adopt this tool's inventory as the living RoPA; review quarterly.

appAssist.how: This tool stores and versions the inventory; re-scans flag drift

controls.title: Compliance dashboard and management reporting
controls.description: A cross-department view of status, open actions and evidence exists for management and audit.
controls.evidenceRequired: Dashboard/report samples
controls.remediation: Use the Phase-2 report and dashboard as the standing artefact.

appAssist.how: This tool generates it

controls.title: Employee and candidate data treated in scope
controls.description: HR/Admin processing (payroll, attendance, recruitment, ID documents) is included in notices, retention and security controls, subject to the s.7(i) employment legitimate-use where applicable.
controls.evidenceRequired: HR data inventory; employee privacy notice
controls.remediation: Extend inventory and notices to employee data.

appAssist.how: HR questionnaire module included

controls.title: SDF status assessed
controls.description: The organisation has assessed whether it is (or is likely to be) notified as a Significant Data Fiduciary based on volume/sensitivity of data processed.
controls.evidenceRequired: SDF assessment note
controls.remediation: Document the assessment; monitor notifications.

appAssist.how: Assessment checklist

controls.title: SDF obligations if notified: DPO in India, annual DPIA + audit, algorithmic due diligence
controls.description: If notified: India-based DPO reporting to the board, independent data auditor, annual DPIA and audit with findings reported to the Board, and due diligence on algorithmic software; observe any data-localisation notifications.
controls.applicability: conditional — only if notified as SDF
controls.evidenceRequired: DPO appointment; DPIA/audit reports
controls.remediation: Stand up SDF programme if/when notified.

appAssist.how: DPIA workflow and audit evidence tracker

controls.title: HTTPS enforced (HTTP redirects to HTTPS)
controls.description: All pages force TLS; plain-HTTP requests redirect.
controls.evidenceRequired: Redirect chain evidence
controls.remediation: 301 all HTTP to HTTPS.

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: HSTS enabled
controls.description: Strict-Transport-Security header present with sensible max-age.
controls.evidenceRequired: Response header capture
controls.remediation: Add HSTS header (max-age >= 15552000).

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: Baseline security headers
controls.description: X-Content-Type-Options, X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors, Referrer-Policy and a CSP are present.
controls.evidenceRequired: Header capture per page
controls.remediation: Add missing headers at the edge/webserver.

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: Session cookies Secure/HttpOnly
controls.description: Cookies set by the site carry Secure and (where appropriate) HttpOnly/SameSite attributes.
controls.evidenceRequired: Set-Cookie capture
controls.remediation: Set Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite on cookies.

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: No server version disclosure
controls.description: Server/X-Powered-By headers do not expose exact software versions.
controls.evidenceRequired: Header capture
controls.remediation: Suppress version tokens.

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: Terms of service published
controls.description: Terms/conditions of use are published and linked.
controls.evidenceRequired: Terms URL
controls.remediation: Publish terms page.

appAssist.how: Verified every scan

controls.title: Cloud connector active with valid read-only credentials
controls.description: A consent-granted, least-privilege cloud connector verifies posture automatically each scan; without it, cloud checkpoints rely on declarations.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Connect a read-only (SecurityAudit) principal via the workspace Connectors page.

appAssist.how: Automated posture verification on every scan

controls.title: Cloud storage blocked from public access
controls.description: Account-level public-access block prevents personal-data stores from being exposed publicly.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Enable the account-level S3 Public Access Block (all four flags).

appAssist.how: Verified every scan; regression raises an alert

controls.title: Cloud storage encrypted at rest
controls.description: Object storage holding personal data has default server-side encryption.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Enable default SSE (AES-256/KMS) on all buckets.

appAssist.how: Per-bucket verification each scan

controls.title: Cloud audit trail enabled and logging
controls.description: Account activity trail exists, is actively logging, and retention meets the one-year log requirement.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail with >=1y retention on its bucket.

appAssist.how: Trail status checked each scan; retention via evidence

controls.title: Network exposure restricted to intended services
controls.description: Security groups do not expose non-web ports (databases, RDP/SSH) to 0.0.0.0/0.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Restrict inbound rules to known CIDRs; use a bastion/VPN for admin ports.

appAssist.how: Exposed-port inventory each scan

controls.title: Managed databases encrypted at rest
controls.description: Managed database instances holding personal data have storage encryption enabled.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Enable StorageEncrypted (requires snapshot-restore for existing instances).

appAssist.how: Per-instance verification each scan

controls.title: Cloud IAM hygiene: root MFA and key rotation
controls.description: Root account has MFA; access keys are rotated at least every 90 days.
controls.evidenceRequired: Cloud API responses captured at scan time
controls.remediation: Enable root MFA; rotate stale access keys.

appAssist.how: Key-age and MFA check each scan
